first_executable_rule: first observed one-minute open strictly after activation
external_level: previous completed UTC-day perpetual trade high or low
paired_index_level: index high or low in the completed five-minute bar that created the previous-day perpetual extreme
event: first current-day perpetual consumption while paired index level remains unconsumed, followed by same-bar trade close back inside
entry: first executable one-minute open after completed event
stop: raid extreme plus 0.10 prior ATR14 beyond the position
target: nearest previous-day open, midpoint, or close in the reversal direction
state_loss: later completed trade and index acceptance beyond the swept paired levels
global_arbitration: earliest executable event; exact ties use larger pre-trade structural reward/risk, then symbol name

stage_policy.2023: diagnostic only because exposed during semantic debugging

ml_gate: do not fit ML unless the 2022 18bp global-slot path is positive and non-sparse and the 24bp path is non-negative
